items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Okay, the gowns, the style, the look – Lena Horne.

ctx.x: So there are people that influenced your style. I think you’ve referred to it in that past, maybe, as osmosis. But, looking back, what do you see in you that came from - places?

Okay, the gowns, the style, the look – Lena Horne. The humor on the floor, Dinah Washington. The sound is Little Jimmy Scott. The phrasing and all that’s Little Jimmy Scott, to me. I heard – I loved him. I loved to hear Jimmy sing. I only heard him. I never saw him until last – when we brought him out to California. I never saw Little Jimmy Scott perform. I heard him, but I never got to see him perform until way late.
So, on your prom night, you go to see Rusty. You sit it. You don’t remember what you sang, do you?
